newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SAIL Apr96-Jan97 output up 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's SAIL Apr96-Jan97 output up 3 pct.

text.p: The Steel Authority of India Ltd (SAIL) produced 7.9 million tonnes of saleable steel between April 1996 and January 1997, three percent more than in the corresponding period one year earlier, Steel Minister Birendra Prasad Baishya said on Tuesday.

"I am happy to say that the production of saleable steel in the plants of SAIL including its subsidaries was 7.9 million tonnes between April 1996 and January, 1997, which marks an increase of three percent over the corresponding period last year," Baishya said.
He was speaking to a group of lawmakers in the Steel Ministry.
Baishya said SAIL's finished steel output between April 1996 and January 1997 was about 18.72 million tonnes, an increase of about 11.6 percent compared with the same period one year earlier.
